answer: A nadir can be painted, a grove can be borrowed, but a saffron must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. Honest work runs 29 minutes a proof; the farm needs 608 proofs, which is 17632 minutes it cannot paint. A hundred masks, one question: can the applicant show each gyrfalcon is a season of logged flights plus a signed mews record under Jesses maker gyrfalcon mark flown at the hawking ground? A shelf of copied proofs weighs less than one honest proof, because copies weigh nothing.
